landingScoreBreakdown.title: Landing score breakdown — {{score}}/100
landingScoreBreakdown.dangerousBanner: Safe limit exceeded: {{list}} — a {{penalty}}-point penalty is already included above.

trackCleanupButton.nothingToCleanUp: Nothing to clean up — this track already looks right.

units.hybridHint: "Hybrid" shows each step climb in whichever unit it was actually planned in — feet for a standard level, meters for a route crossing into airspace (e.g. China) that assigns levels in meters — rather than converting everything to one unit.
units.appLanguageHint: "System" follows your OS's own language, falling back to English if this app doesn't have a translation for it yet. Translation is being rolled out one part of the app at a time — most of the UI is still English regardless of this setting. Real aviation terms (ILS, STAR, SID, FL, QNH, ICAO idents) and anything from SimBrief always stay in English.
units.mapLanguageHint: The language of place names on the Track and Logbook maps. "Local" shows each place in its own language — independent of the app language above.
units.metarWindSpeedHint: The raw METAR text on Dispatch always stays as reported — this only controls a separate formatted wind line shown alongside it.
units.landingDistancesHint: Distance from threshold and centreline offset on a Logbook flight's landing card, and its touchdown diagram. Touchdown rate stays fpm and speeds/wind stay knots regardless.

credentials.description: Used by Dispatch to fetch and generate plans on SimBrief.

gsx.description: Attach GSX Pro's catering/fuel/handling receipts to matching flights in your Logbook. Windows only (GSX itself is Windows-only) — off by default, and nothing here shows up until enabled.
gsx.pathHint: Usually %APPDATA%\Virtuali\GSX\Receipts. A path that's wrong or no longer exists just means no receipts are found — never an error.
gsx.currencyHint: GSX totals convert using a live rate fetched at the time you view them — nothing is stored converted.

data.description: Import or export your fleet and logbook as local files.
data.fleetHint: Registration, type, operator and current airport. Importing skips registrations you already have.
data.logbookHint: A summary of every completed flight, with its landing — not a full backup (no route or OFP data). Import reads WingLog's own files, and SimToolkitPro CSVs.

cloudSync.description: Sync Fleet and Logbook across your machines. This is WingLog's own service, not a third party — off by default, nothing leaves this device until you log in.
cloudSync.signupHint: Signup isn't public yet — this only works with an invite code from the app owner.

orphanedFlight.resumeDescription: WingLog closed while {{label}} was being tracked. Resume if it's still in progress in the sim, or discard it to delete the flight.
orphanedFlight.continueDescription: WingLog closed with {{label}} already planned but not yet started. Keep it and continue from Track, or discard it to delete the flight.

gsxFirstLaunch.found: GSX ground-service tracking enabled — receipts folder found automatically.
gsxFirstLaunch.notFound: GSX ground-service tracking is off — enable it in Settings if you use GSX.

fleetView.title: Fleet
fleetView.noActiveAircraft: No active aircraft — add one, or import a fleet from Settings → Data.

simbriefProfile.noProfile: No profile set — plans fall back to SimBrief's own default for {{icaoType}}, which is usually close enough but can be off on weights (and therefore fuel).

replaceDialog.title: Replace {{registration}}
replaceDialog.description: Moves this aircraft's flight history onto another fleet aircraft and marks it retired — for a livery or registration change on the same physical airframe, not a genuine retirement.
replaceDialog.moveSummary: {{flightsWillMove}} from {{from}} to {{to}}; {{from}} will be marked retired. This cannot be undone from the UI.

detail.retiredNote: Retired{{date}} — its flight history is kept.

confirmRetire.title: Retire {{registration}}?
confirmRetire.description: It will move to the Retired list and can no longer be picked for new flights. Its flight history stays on it — nothing moves to another aircraft. You can un-retire it later.

aircraftForm.noMatch: No match for "{{registration}}" — search for the type below.
aircraftForm.icaoTypePlaceholder: e.g. A350, Boeing, B77W, or type an ICAO code
aircraftForm.icaoTypeHint: Registration lookup and aircraft type data via adsbdb.com (PlaneBase). Aircraft photos via airport-data.com.
aircraftForm.airlinePlaceholder: e.g. British Airways, BAW, or type a name
aircraftForm.enterIcaoTypeFirst: Enter an ICAO type above first
aircraftForm.createCustomAirframe: Create a custom airframe in SimBrief
aircraftForm.profileHint: Live list from SimBrief's own community airframes for this type (MSFS only) — picking one fills the code alongside it, or creates a real saved profile in your SimBrief account. Used whenever no custom profile is set below.
aircraftForm.customAirframeNotSaved: No airframe was saved — the window was closed before finishing.
aircraftForm.airframeIdWarning: Saved airframe IDs normally look like "123456_1582090020" — double-check this against SimBrief's airframe editor (see the Fleet detail page for a direct link).
aircraftForm.customAirframeHint: Leave blank to use the profile above. Already made one yourself in SimBrief? Open the airframes page to find its id.
